dengue.symptoms: High fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, joint and muscle pain, rash, mild bleeding (nose or gums).
dengue.prevention: Avoid standing water, use mosquito nets, use repellents, wear long-sleeved clothes, ensure community vector control.
dengue.advice: If you have high fever and severe pain, seek medical help. Stay hydrated and monitor warning signs.

malaria.symptoms: Fever, chills, headache, muscle aches, malaise. Severe cases may cause anemia and organ failure.
malaria.prevention: Use insecticide-treated bed nets, indoor residual spraying, remove stagnant water.
malaria.advice: Get tested quickly and start antimalarial treatment as prescribed by a doctor.

covid.symptoms: Fever, dry cough, tiredness. Some have loss of taste or smell, sore throat, headache, body aches.
covid.prevention: Vaccination, masks in crowded places, regular hand washing, isolation when symptomatic.
covid.advice: Test if symptomatic and follow local health guidance on isolation and treatment.

flu.symptoms: Fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches.
flu.prevention: Get flu vaccination annually, wash hands frequently, avoid close contact with sick people.
flu.advice: Rest, drink plenty of fluids, and take paracetamol if needed. Seek medical help if severe.

diabetes.symptoms: Frequent urination, increased thirst, weight loss, fatigue, blurred vision.
diabetes.prevention: Maintain a healthy weight, eat a balanced diet, exercise regularly, monitor blood sugar levels.
diabetes.advice: Consult a doctor for diagnosis and treatment. Follow prescribed diet, exercise, and medication.

asthma.symptoms: Shortness of breath, chest tightness, wheezing, coughing at night or early morning.
asthma.prevention: Avoid triggers like smoke, dust, pollen, and cold air. Follow preventive inhaler treatment if prescribed.
asthma.advice: Use inhalers as directed. Seek medical help if breathing becomes very difficult or symptoms worsen.

typhoid.symptoms: Prolonged fever, abdominal pain, headache, weakness, constipation or diarrhea.
typhoid.prevention: Drink clean water, practice good hand hygiene, avoid street food in unsafe areas.
typhoid.advice: Seek medical care for antibiotics. Stay hydrated and follow doctor’s advice.

tuberculosis.symptoms: Persistent cough (more than 3 weeks), chest pain, coughing blood, weight loss, night sweats, fever.
tuberculosis.prevention: Early detection and treatment, vaccination (BCG), good ventilation in living spaces.
tuberculosis.advice: Consult a doctor immediately for diagnosis and complete the full course of TB medication.

hypertension.symptoms: Often no clear symptoms. In some cases: headaches, dizziness, blurred vision, chest pain.
hypertension.prevention: Eat low-salt healthy diet, exercise regularly, avoid stress, maintain healthy weight.
hypertension.advice: Get blood pressure checked regularly. Follow doctor’s prescription and lifestyle advice.

pneumonia.symptoms: Cough with phlegm, chest pain, fever, chills, difficulty breathing, fatigue.
pneumonia.prevention: Vaccination, hand washing, avoid smoking, maintain good hygiene.
pneumonia.advice: Seek medical attention for antibiotics or antivirals. Rest and drink fluids.

chickenpox.symptoms: Itchy rash with red spots/blisters, fever, tiredness, loss of appetite, headache.
chickenpox.prevention: Vaccination, avoid contact with infected people.
chickenpox.advice: Stay isolated until blisters heal. Relieve itching with calamine lotion. Drink fluids and rest.
